description: This file defines the SupervisorUserRole class within the OrangeHRM system. It manages user roles with a supervisor level, including access to employee IDs, location IDs, and performance reviews, utilizing various service traits and methods.

classes.name: SupervisorUserRole
classes.description: Represents a supervisor user role with methods to retrieve subordinate employee IDs, location IDs, and performance review IDs. Implements role-specific access control logic within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LocationService instance used by this role.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns accessible entity IDs based on entity type, such as Employee, Location, or PerformanceReview.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of employees subordinate to the supervisor.

methods.name: getAccessibleLocationIds
methods.description: Retrieves location IDs associated with subordinate employees.

methods.name: getAccessibleReviewIds
methods.description: Gets performance review IDs where the supervisor is a reviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns a list of quick launch features available to the supervisor role.
